text: Erwin Pascual, Manager, Solid Waste Policy and Planning, and Emily Marmoreo, Senior Project Manager, Solid Waste Policy and Planning will give a presentation on Single-Use and Takeaway Items Reduction Strategy Consultation. The purpose of this presentation is that staff are seeking to develop the next stage of the Single-Use and Takeaway Item (SUTI) Reduction Strategy and SUTI Bylaw. Currently the SUTI Bylaw includes requirements for retail businesses to reduce the amount of SUTI distributed. The next stage explores the potential to expand the Bylaw to event venues and events and additional reusable food container and beverage cup requirements.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
